description: This file implements hash lookup functions for Git objects, including a binary search to locate object IDs within a sorted table of hashes, and another binary search for hash values using a fanout table. It appears to be part of Git's internal hashing and lookup mechanisms.

methods.name: uint32_t take2(const struct object_id * oid,size_t ofs)
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit value from object_id hash at a specified offset.

methods.name: int oid_pos(const struct object_id * oid,const void * table,size_t nr,oid_access_fn fn)
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position of an object ID within a sorted table, based on a provided access function.

methods.name: int bsearch_hash(const unsigned char * hash,const uint32_t * fanout_nbo,const unsigned char * table,size_t stride,uint32_t * result)
methods.description: Performs a binary search for a hash in a table using a fanout array and returning the index if found.

ctags.name: bsearch_hash
ctags.signature: (const unsigned char * hash,const uint32_t * fanout_nbo,const unsigned char * table,size_t stride,uint32_t * result)

ctags.pattern: /^int oid_pos(const struct object_id *oid, const void *table, size_t nr,$/
ctags.signature: (const struct object_id * oid,const void * table,size_t nr,oid_access_fn fn)
